[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, a two-shot medium angle shows <Subject 1> holding the <Subject 3> graphics card in both hands with a satisfied smile while <Subject 2> gives a happy thumbs-up and laughs, as dappled daylight falls across the imperial palace film set.
